test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A fruit seller has a sale of Rs.10,435, Rs.9,927, Rs.10,855, Rs.10,230 and Rs.9,562 for five consecutive months. How much sale (in Rs.) must he have in the sixth month so that he gets an average sale of Rs.10,500?
solution:
**Given:**

A fruit seller has a sale for five months = Rs. 10,435, Rs. 9,927, Rs. 10,855, Rs. 10,230 and Rs. 9,562 

**Formula used:**

Sum of observations = Average × Number of observations<
